Name: Judas Barsabbas
Role: Prophet; Messenger of the Jerusalem Church
Summary: Judas Barsabbas was a leading man among the Jerusalem brethren and a prophet, sent with Silas to Antioch to confirm the Council's letter by word of mouth, exhorting and confirming the brethren. He is distinct from Judas Iscariot, Judas son of James, Judas brother of Jesus, and Judas of Galilee.
KeyStory: Judas Barsabbas carried the Council's letter to Antioch and stayed to exhort the brethren with many words.
LifeLesson: Letters need living voices. Judas Barsabbas carried a decision and a confirmation in the same journey.
